name: editorial-illustrations
description: > Generate meaning-carrying editorial data-illustrations in the monotykamary / Linear aesthetic (near-black grayscale, Inter display + mono labels, hairline framed figures) with a single coral accent. This is a GENERATIVE GUIDE, not a template gallery: it teaches the "claim -> geometry" method so any session can invent the RIGHT figure for what a post actually argues, then render it as a self-contained, theme-aware, reduced-motion-safe HTML/SVG figure. Use when writing/illustrating a blog post,
author: huytieu
summary_zh: 一套将文章观点转化为极简数据插图的生成指南，适合为博客制作主题自适应、低动效的 HTML/SVG 图形。
